description: Make a tool for a person (tools.made-tool@1) on their behalf: an agent such as Actor or Codes drafts and saves a tool the person asked for. X-OV-Subject (usr_) names the person, who owns the tool. POST /api/v1/made-tools/draft with { description, kind: prompt|code } drafts the fields from words (a model run paid from the person's allowance, Vibes or own keys); POST /api/v1/made-tools with the make form's fields saves it, always private when an agent makes it (only the person publishes, on openvibe.tools/make), answered with the tool. Without X-OV-Subject the token is refused. Changing or deleting a tool stays the person's own.
